paper.title_en: Reflected entropy and islands in JT gravity from partial dimensional reduction
paper.abstract_en: We study how mixed-state correlations reorganize across island transitions in Jackiw-Teitelboim gravity coupled to a non-gravitating bath. Using the partial-dimensional-reduction realization of double holography, we compute reflected entropy for adjacent and disjoint radiation regions in the vacuum and in the thermofield-double state of an eternal black hole. Reflected entropy probes the internal partition of the entanglement wedge and therefore resolves structure that is invisible to the ordinary Page curve: its dominant saddle can change even when the entropy saddle of the union remains fixed, and it vanishes at leading order when the entanglement wedge disconnects. We show that the lower-dimensional reflected-island description agrees, to leading order in the dynamical brane fluctuation, with the higher-dimensional defect-extremal-surface picture. The finite-angle comparison further suggests a projection-covariant identification of island and brane endpoints at linear order. The resulting Page-like curves and Markov gaps provide a geometric probe of the reorganization of the purification and of non-Markovian, multipartite correlation structure during island transitions.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文在JT引力与非引力浴耦合的框架下研究岛屿相变中的混合态关联重组，利用部分维度约化实现双重全息，计算反射熵，涉及Page曲线与马尔可夫间隙等量子引力基础问题，理论深度与方法严谨性信号较强，适合推荐阅读。
decision.title_zh: 部分维度约化下JT引力中的反射熵与岛屿
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究了在Jackiw-Teitelboim引力与非引力浴耦合的情形下，混合态关联如何跨越岛屿相变而重组。利用双重全息的部分维度约化实现，我们计算了真空态以及永恒黑洞热场双态中相邻与不相交辐射区域的反射熵。反射熵探测纠缠楔的内部划分，因此能分辨普通Page曲线不可见的结构：即使并集的熵鞍点保持不变，其主导鞍点也可能改变，并且当纠缠楔断开时，它在领头阶消失。我们表明，低维反射-岛屿描述在动力学膜涨落的领头阶上与高维缺陷-极值曲面图像一致。有限角度的比较进一步提示，在线性阶上岛屿端点与膜端点存在投影协变的对应。由此得到的类Page曲线和马尔可夫间隙为岛屿相变期间纯化重组以及非马尔可夫、多体关联结构提供了几何探测手段。
